name: OSINT MCP Server
description: A unified Open Source Intelligence toolkit that integrates data sources like Censys, Shodan, and LinkedIn for comprehensive infrastructure and identity research. It enables users to perform automated email verification, vulnerability scanning, and person or company enrichment directly through Claude.
